title: bug: .moe task JSON persists raw bidi/format characters from tool text
description:
Repro: task-44b44ccac62f4657890f98ff450738c8. Its complete_step(step-2) note and complete_task summary were sent with backslash-u escapes, and the agent tool-call layer decoded the non-control ones. As a result, .moe/tasks/task-44b44ccac62f4657890f98ff450738c8.json now holds literal U+061C, U+200B-U+200F, U+202A-U+202E (incl. RLO), U+2060-U+206F and U+FEFF. Board commits stage that file, which triggers GitHub hidden-Unicode / Trojan Source warnings.

Fix idea: have the daemon's .moe JSON writer emit those code points (plus U+2028/U+2029) as JSON escapes. That is byte-safe and value-identical. Add a regression test.
definitionOfDone: Every .moe JSON record the daemon writes encodes U+061C, U+200B-U+200F, U+2028-U+202E, U+2060-U+206F and U+FEFF as JSON escape sequences, so the file bytes contain none of those code points.
Parsed values are unchanged by the escaping (a round-trip test with a U+202E-bearing note/summary).
A test proves a task note/summary containing U+202E is written without the raw character and reads back identical.
